SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. S. P. REGISTRY. File No. 5796）
REPORT
Date April 12, 1934.

Subject (in full) Functioning of Kuomintang Agent in the Settlement.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang.

Li Siau, Secret Agent No.3 in the employ of the
Kuomintang Headquarters is not known to the Public
Safety Bureau.
The Kuomintang headquarters were informed through
Mr. Loh Yuen Fu (陸元甫) in accordance with your
instructions.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：J2 / See other / FILE / of TP）
（批：Reg. Passed to you. JSR 12/4.）

报告
日期：1934年4月12日。

事由（全称）：国民党特工在租界内的活动情况。

由谭绍良警司制作并呈报。

受雇于国民党总部的秘密特工第3号李笑（Li Siau），公共安全局对其并不知晓。
已遵照阁下的指示，通过陆元甫先生通知了国民党总部。

谭绍良
警司

政治部主管警官

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date 11 / 4 / 34

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
FELONS. B...REGISTRY.
No. D 5796
Station
Date 11 / 4 / 34）

Subject (in full) Assistance to Chinese Authorities.

Made by D.P.S. Lingard Forwarded by JBRm D.I.

Li Siau(李笑), secret agent attached to the Investigation
Section of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Headquarters,
holder of Card No. 0003, valid from March 1 to April 1, 1934,
reported to Sinza Station that at 2.30 p.m. 10-4-34 he saw a
male Chinese named Zung(康 ), age about 20, native of Szechuen,
whom he recognised as being a member of the Fah Nan District
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, on Bubbling Well Road
near the Race Course. He shadowed the suspect but was soon
observed by the latter who fled. The agent pursued him north
along Myburgh Road where he saw the suspect turn into Lane 194
where he lost sight of him.

The matter was investigated by D.I. MacFarlene and C.D.C.
292 of Sinza Station in conjunction with D.P.S. Lingard and Clerk
Fang, Special Branch, and it was ascertained that only four
Chinese style houses are located in Lane 194 - Nos. 14 to 17 -
and that they are occupied by two families named Yao(姚 ) and
Ting(丁 ) respectively, the former occupying houses Nos. 14,
15 and 17, while the latter, a medical practitioner, resides in
house No.16.

When questioned by the Police, Wong Ts Ding(王子定), the
private watchman of the alleyway, strongly denied that any person
had entered the alleyway as reported by Agent Li Siau.

The following is a description of the suspect :-
Age about 20, native of Szechuen, square face, height 5' 6", slim
build, wearing navy blue coloured long gown and felt hat.

No effort was made by Li Siau to secure the assistance of
the Police on street duty to apprehend the suspect, who, it
transpires, knows the agent personally.

Copy passed to Sinza. JBRm 11/4 D.P.S. Lingard
Officer i/c Special Branch.

S.2，政治部。
报告
日期：1934年4月11日

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
重罪犯……登记处。
编号 D 5796
警局
日期：1934年4月11日）

事由（全称）：协助中国当局。

由林加德副警司制作，由 JBRm 督察转发。

隶属于上海特别区国民党总部调查科的秘密特工李笑（Li Siau，李笑），持有第0003号证件，有效期为1934年3月1日至4月1日，向静安寺捕房报告称，1934年4月10日下午2时30分，他在跑马厅附近的静安寺路看见一名名叫康（Zung，音译）的中国男子，年龄约20岁，四川籍，他认出此人是中国共产党法南区委的成员。他跟踪了该嫌疑人，但很快被对方察觉，嫌疑人随即逃跑。该特工沿麦勃赫路（Myburgh Road）向北追赶，看见嫌疑人转入194弄，随后失去了目标踪迹。

此事由麦法伦督察和静安寺捕房第292号华籍侦探会同政治部副警司林加德及文员方某进行调查，查明194弄内仅有四幢中式房屋——即14至17号——分别由姚（Yao，姚）姓和丁（Ting，丁）姓两户人家居住，前者居住于14、15和17号，后者为一名医师，居住于16号。

警方讯问时，该弄堂的私人更夫王子定（Wong Ts Ding）强烈否认有任何人按照特工李笑的报告进入过该弄堂。

嫌疑人特征描述如下：
年龄约20岁，四川籍，方脸，身高5英尺6英寸，身材瘦削，身穿深蓝色长衫，头戴毡帽。

李笑并未设法寻求街头执勤警察的协助以逮捕该嫌疑人，而据查，该嫌疑人认识这名特工。

副本已送交静安寺捕房。JBRm 4月11日 林加德
政治部主管副警司
